phase: Phase 5 — Matchup balance pass; combat rules hardened
polish: Every race matchup now sits between 31% and 69% over 36 seeded games per pair (was 0-8% for Mummy vs Human and Robot vs Mummy). Counter rules are honest to the codex, and timed games no longer end in draws.
completed: Race system: Human / Demon / Robot / Mummy with passives (Formation, Rage, Armor Core, Undeath)
48 data-driven units (12 per race) with tags, counters, armour, abilities
Procedural pixel rig for 10 body types (humanoid, small, big, giant, quad, bug, flyer, vehicle, mech, mount)
4 base designs (castle, fortress, factory, temple) with damage states

Abilities: charge, splash, cone, pierce beam, chain lightning, multishot, healing/shield/rally auras, burn, slow, stun, lifesteal, summon-on-kill, burst-on-death, revive, regen, inferno nova, orbital beam, raise dead
Race selection screen with reveal transition; army roster screen; campaign with 4 chapters / 12 stages
12-card deployment bar with hotkeys 1-9 0 - =, race chips, counter hints, tooltips
Race-aware enemy AI: gold-weighted counter scoring, waves, budget discipline, emergency defence, race personalities
Centralised balance: tier value curve + race power knobs (src/data/balance.js), duel lab, race matrix harness
Browser QA: all 48 unit cards deployed through real input; pause, resume and restart verified for every race
Mobile landscape HUD verified at 844x390 with all 12 cards and controls inside the viewport
Eight-minute time limit, draw handling and late siege rules; seven automated gameplay/data regressions
Counter system: weakAgainst is a real +30% modifier, race-wide tags (UNDEAD, MECHANICAL) capped at +20%, ARMORED reserved for heavy plate
Smooth armour curve (big hits punch through, small hits blunted, 45% floor) and fractional damage so swarm units are not rounded to nothing
Value normaliser counts formation, rage, summons and revive realistically; per-unit TUNE override layer (src/data/tuning.js)
AI regroups into counter-waves instead of trickle-feeding squads into a winning army; time-limit tiebreak by surviving army value
Graphic Bible (docs/graphic-bible.html): 24-section art/animation/UI standard rendered live from the rig, atlas, themes and CSS kit
improving: Robot vs Mummy still leans Mummy (31%)
Long even games often go to the 8-minute tiebreak
issues: Robot melee line (Combat/Spider/Flame/Tesla) underperforms its ranged line in every matchup
Duel lab (equal-gold 1v1) disagrees with full-game results, so it is a hint, not an oracle
Seeded matrix still swings ±4 games per pair at n=24
critic: Round 6 balance pass: Human vs Mummy was 11:1 because Human armour, formation and priest healing made Mummy chaff harmless, and the AI fed single squads into the winning army. Robot vs Mummy hit 0:24 mid-pass when the ARMORED tag was cleaned up; fixed with Pharaoh raise nerf, Plague Priest tune and Robot melee tunes. Verified in the real browser: battle runs, results screen shows the new tiebreak text.

balance.demon: 44% over 106 games; even vs Human and Mummy
balance.robot: 50% over 107 games; strong vs Human/Demon, weak vs Mummy
balance.mummy: 53% over 108 games; beats Robot 69%, loses to Human 39%

playtest: 36-game pairs: Human-Demon 20:16, Human-Robot 13:23, Human-Mummy 22:14, Demon-Robot 14:20, Demon-Mummy 17:19, Robot-Mummy 11:24
Average game 6.3 min; no game exceeded the 8-minute limit; no draws
Browser: Mummy vs Robot battle at 2x speed, results screen with tiebreak hint, no console errors
